title: SketchGuard: Scaling Byzantine-Robust Decentralized Federated Learning via Sketch-Based Screening
abstract: arXiv:2510.07922v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Byzantine-robust decentralized federated learning (DFL) protects peer-to-peer training from malicious clients. The dominant defenses rely on similarity-based filtering, in which each client exchanges full model vectors with every neighbor before any filtering decision; this communication grows with the model dimension and scales poorly as models grow. We propose SketchGuard, which decouples screening from aggregation: clients screen neighbors in a compact Count Sketch domain and fetch full models only from those that pass the screen. We show this idea is insecure when implemented naively. Because the sketch is a fixed, publicly known linear map, an adaptive adversary can hide an arbitrarily large perturbation in its null space, so the poisoned model passes both the sketch-domain filter and the re-sketch verification. We prove this vulnerability and close it with commit-then-sketch, a one-message protocol that draws the sketch seed on

translated_title: SketchGuard：通过草图筛选实现可扩展的拜占庭鲁棒去中心化联邦学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.07922v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：拜占庭鲁棒的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）保护点对点训练免受恶意客户端的侵害。主要的防御方法依赖于基于相似性的过滤，其中每个客户端在与任何邻居进行过滤决策之前，需交换完整模型向量；这种通信量随模型维度增长，并且随着模型规模增大而扩展性差。我们提出SketchGuard，它将筛选与聚合分离：客户端在紧凑的计数草图域中筛选邻居，仅从通过筛选的邻居获取完整模型。我们展示了这一想法在朴素实现下是不安全的。由于草图是一个固定的、公开已知的线性映射，自适应对手可以在其零空间中隐藏任意大的扰动，从而使被投毒的模型同时通过草图域过滤和重新草图验证。我们证明了这一漏洞，并通过提交后草图（一种单消息协议，在绘制草图种子时）加以弥补。
tldr: 本文提出SketchGuard，一种通过计数草图域筛选邻居、仅获取通过筛选模型的去中心化联邦学习防御方法，并针对其朴素实现的安全漏洞，引入提交后草图协议以抵御自适应攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SketchGuard, a Byzantine-robust decentralized federated learning defense that screens neighbors in a compact Count Sketch domain and fetches full models only from those passing, and addresses the security vulnerability of naive implementation with a commit-then-sketch protocol against adaptive attacks.
